verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents white-labeling, rebranding, or embedding the Windmill platform inside another product for that product's customers. Self-hosting, the app builder, and free app guests who sign in through your identity provider are related but different capabilities, so they earn no credit. Embedding is a fair axis for an automation platform, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a developer, I can embed the automation platform white-label inside my own product for my customers
